subject: SAME clause
notes: cite.py --check 12.4.6.4.4 "A logical record in the shared memory area is a logical record of each file open in the output mode and of the most recently-read file open in the input mode" -> OK GR2; cite.py --check 12.4.6.4.4 "This is equivalent to an implicit redefinition of the area with records aligned on the leftmost byte position" -> OK GR2. BindIoControl chains each listed file's first record as an implicit RedefinitionKind.SameRecordArea redefinition of the first listed file's record (the multi-01 FD mechanism) and records SameRecordAreaPeers for out-of-line records (D-FRA). Probe gr2_mixed (SEQUENTIAL X(4) / RELATIVE X(2)+X(6) / LINE SEQUENTIAL X(10)): MOVE to F3-REC shows F1=ABCD F2A=AB F2B=CDEFGH (leftmost alignment across unequal lengths); MOVE to F1-REC shows F3=WXYZEFGHIJ; after READ F2 F1-REC=1234, after READ F1 F2-A=WX (most-recently-read file's record occupies the area). Availability sentence (area available while any member open) and the most-recently-read sentence pinned by conformance:cases/12.4.6.4-SAME/pb235_same_record_area_close (spec-derived, CLOSE GR7 + this GR2); RELEASE interplay by conformance:cases/14.9.32-RELEASE/l1_release_same_record_area. The 'only one file also in a file-area SAME clause may be open' sentence is a program constraint (no specified check). Residual: a record shape with a byte-window residue is still refused loud COBOL0899 (DataBinder ByteWindowResidueOf; since PB981 pointer/dynamic-length/national shapes ride, so no conforming shape is known to reach it) - noted, not a measured defect. [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (the SAME clause is base I-O-CONTROL language in every edition; no Annex E change entry names it)]
